label: Web Console access setting
type: the setting controlling whether the Couchbase Web Console is reachable over HTTP, HTTPS only, or not at all. Governs port:18091 versus its cleartext counterpart.
note: Promoted as the smallest of the three wire settings and the only one that is a UI-reachability control rather than a cryptographic one. Kept in tls: because that is where its documentation lives and where an administrator will look for it.
